title: Packaging check
subtitle: Client label artwork ↔ ingredient list ↔ our rules
aiNotConnected: AI is not connected — departments write their remarks directly into the email.

form.artworkHint: Drag the artwork here or click — JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 15 MB
form.ingredientsPlaceholder: Paste the ingredient list and nutrition values…
form.ingredientsFileHint: PDF, image, DOCX or TXT — optional
form.notePlaceholder: What the client asked, deadline, special requests… (optional)
form.ingredientsRequired: Enter the ingredient list or attach a document
form.marketsHint: The AI checks language and national requirements against these markets.
form.clientMessagePlaceholder: Paste what the client wrote — question, request, comment…
form.attachmentsHint: Drag one or more files here or click — JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF, up to 10 × 15 MB
form.filesRejected: Some files were not added (allowed: JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF up to 15 MB, at most {{max}}).

detail.aiNotConfigured: AI is not connected. Departments write their remarks directly into the email.
detail.confirmDelete: Delete this check with all rounds and files?
detail.readOnly: This round is closed — read only.
detail.usesEarlierArtwork: The AI uses the artwork from
detail.aiSkipped: Nothing to review — no artwork and no client message. Departments can add remarks manually.

close.title: Send email — round {{n}}
close.blocked: All departments must approve before sending.
close.override: As top management you can send it anyway.
close.hint: The text is copied — paste it into your email to the client. The round is closed.

newRound.title: New round {{n}}
newRound.hint: Each new message from the client is a new round — a question, new images or corrected artwork. Nothing is mandatory; the AI uses the latest images and ingredient list given.

rulesPage.subtitle: AI checks the artwork against these rules. Each rule has a responsible sector.
rulesPage.textPlaceholder: e.g. Ingredients are listed in descending order of weight
rulesPage.empty: No rules yet. Quality and top management can add rules.
rulesPage.readOnlyHint: Rules are maintained by Quality Assurance and top management.

email.title: Email to client
email.progress: Each department edits and approves its own remarks — {{done}}/{{total}} approved. Sales sends the email.
email.empty: No remarks — this part is left out of the email.
email.editHint: One remark per line, short and clear, in English — it goes to the client as-is. Saving withdraws the approval.
